We provide an integration platform that lets B2B software companies add integrations to their platforms in hours and days instead of weeks and months. Our customers love us because we are innovative, quick, friendly and provide integrations for systems that others dare not touch. We are a young dynamic SaaS Startup born in Düsseldorf who believe in working hard and having fun while doing it. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship. The role Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team. What you will do Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way. Bring real observability to the platform Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source. Raise the bar on security and reliability Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Build product and level up the team You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build. What you bring Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents. Production debugging: You’ve chased down latency spikes, timeouts and flaky dependencies, and you know how to go from “something is slow” to the root cause. Azure: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Azure. Observability: Experience instrumenting services with tracing, structured logging and metrics, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar. Infrastructure-as-code mindset: You codify infrastructure rather than clicking through consoles. Security by default: You think about secrets, access management, and compliance as part of the work, not as an afterthought. Backend skills: You’re comfortable writing production code in TypeScript/Node.js and enjoy shipping features, not only keeping the lights on. Pragmatism and mentoring: You pick the simplest setup that works. You enjoy helping less experienced engineers grow, and you’re excited to set the standards for how we run our platform. What we offer First-hand experience building a fast-growing tech startup Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere Steep learning curve and a varied job with interesting projects and technologies Work fully remote or in our office in Düsseldorf Fun offsites where the team gets together to work and play One-time allowance for improving your home office Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership Laptop and work equipment 30 days of PTO + Local holidays

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Developer - Remote
review_candidates.description: About The Company ICF is a global consulting and technology services provider dedicated to making a positive impact in the world. With a focus on solving complex challenges across various sectors, including health, environment, and social programs, ICF combines industry expertise with innovative technology solutions. The company prides itself on fostering an inclusive and collaborative work environment that empowers its employees to deliver meaningful results for clients worldwide. Recognized for its commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, ICF offers a dynamic workplace where professionals can grow and contribute to impactful projects that improve lives and communities globally. About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer to join our Global Health and Development (GHD) team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing and developing applications that leverage artificial intelligence to enhance global health survey programs. Your work will involve creating secure, scalable, and offline-capable applications, APIs, and data services that support national institutions and survey teams. Collaborating with AI engineers, survey experts, designers, and international partners, you will take solutions from initial prototypes to fully operational production systems. This position offers the flexibility of remote work within the United States, with occasional international travel, and is contingent upon program funding approval. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) with at least 5 years of professional full stack development experience, or Master’s degree with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience At least 1 year of experience integrating large language models (LLMs) into production systems with a focus on error handling, security, and reliability Minimum 1 year of experience working with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines U.S. citizenship required for federal government contract compliance Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern front-end frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue Strong back-end development skills in Python or other modern languages such as Node.js, Go, Java, or C# Experience with relational databases and SQL; NoSQL experience is a plus Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs Proven ability to implement authentication, authorization, and audit logging in production applications Experience with agentic coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex for specifying, reviewing, and testing code Responsibilities Develop a governed data-access application enabling users to explore data using natural language, ensuring privacy and security through access controls, audit logs, and disclosure risk management Create offline-first field tools for interviewers and supervisors that operate reliably on low-end devices with intermittent connectivity and synchronize seamlessly upon reconnection Integrate AI services into applications by working closely with AI engineers to expose model pipelines via well-designed APIs, including MCP connectors for data accessibility in AI assistants Specify and build products using agentic coding tools, including writing detailed specifications, reviewing, testing, and owning the resulting code Design data schemas and services for survey metadata, microdata, and AI-processed results, ensuring data integrity and accessibility Ensure applications are production-ready by writing well-tested, maintainable code, and producing comprehensive documentation for partner institutions to operate and publish tools independently Communicate progress effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including survey experts, program leaders, and partner organizations Benefits Competitive salary range: $81,499 to $138,549 based on experience and qualifications Flexible remote work within the United States Opportunity to contribute to impactful global health initiatives Collaborative and inclusive work environment Professional development and growth opportunities Comprehensive health and wellness benefits (details available upon request) Paid time off and holidays Equal Opportunity ICF is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, gender, age, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees with disabilities or religious needs. For more information, please review our EEO policy at https://www.icf.com/legal/equal-employment-opportunity.

review_candidates.title: Furniture Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Role Description The Furniture Sales Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This role involves driving sales through technical expertise, communicating with clients to understand their needs, providing product recommendations, offering technical support, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. The sales Engineer will work closely with both the sales and design team to deliver tailored solutions for customers. Day-to-day tasks include meeting with clients, presenting product options and technical specifications, conducting site visits and measurements, and following up on leads and ongoing projects. Qualifications Strong technical understanding of furniture design, materials, manufacturing processes, and installation methods. Proven experience in sales engineering, showroom and technical sales, with the ability to interpret drawings, specifications, and client requirements. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build long-term client relationships and handle multiple stakeholders. Solid organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage several projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. Proficiency in basic office and collaboration tools (e.g., MS Office, email, CAD and design softwares) Bachelor’s degree in a relative field Previous experience in the furniture sales industry or in interior projects in Egypt or the region is a must.

review_candidates.title: Junior Software Engineer (Greece, Chania based)
review_candidates.description: About the role: We are looking for a passionate Junior Software Engineer to join our Development Lab at SKY express , based in Chania. In this role, you will support the development and maintenance of software applications, APIs, and backend services that support key airline operations. Working closely with Senior Software Engineers and cross-functional teams, you will contribute to delivering reliable and scalable technology solutions. Responsibilities: Develop and maintain software applications, RESTful APIs, and backend services that support business and operational needs. Collaborate with Senior Software Engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver technical solutions aligned with business requirements. Support testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and technical documentation activities to ensure reliable and high-quality software delivery. Follow coding standards, participate in code reviews, and contribute to continuous improvement of software quality and development practices. Contribute to team initiatives, development processes, and internal tools while taking ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables. Competencies: Strong problem‑solving and analytical thinking. Good teamwork, communication, and collaboration skills. Eagerness to learn and take on new challenges. High attention to detail and ability to follow technical guidelines. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). Minimum 1 year of professional experience in software development. Exposure to modern programming languages and technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js and SQL. Familiarity with any frontend library/framework such as Angular, React, Vue etc. Familiarity with Git. Fluency in Greek and English (verbal and written). Why Join Us? Competitive Salary & Allowances. Continuous Training & Professional Development. Travel benefits on SKY express flights (extended to first-degree family members). Join an airline with a strong commitment to safety, reliability, and operational excellence. A supportive and collaborative work culture that values innovation and safety. About SKY express: SKY express , a member of the International Air Transport Association (IATA), holds a leading position in the Greek market, operating the country’s largest domestic network with 33 destinations. At the same time, it is continuously expanding its international reach, serving 29 international destinations and forging strategic partnerships with top global airlines. The airline operates the youngest fleet among Greek carriers, consisting of 30 state-of-the-art aircraft, that combine comfort, advanced technology and a low environmental footprint. In 2025 , SKY express, was honored by the European Regions Airline Association (ERA) with the highest distinction “Airline of the Year ”, in Europe, as well as the award for “Regional Connectivity Airline”. Join us on this remarkable journey! Applicants’ personal data will be used for recruitment purposes only and applications will be treated as strictly confidential. Please note that only shortlisted candidates shall be contacted.
